children: Lookonchain said Unipcs spent $67,700 to buy 10.9 million tokens tied to contract address 0x07f5...2241 and has never sold them. According to Odaily, the position is now worth $7.52 million, with a profit of $7.45 million and a return of more than 110 times, while the portfolio increased by $6.3 million in one day.

title: Unipcs Turns $67,700 Token Bet Into $7.52 Million Holding
